name: Jump Bar
summary: A command palette that grows out of the header search pill, finds as you type and runs with a comet
about: A keyboard-first command menu for a small business app. The search pill in the header grows into the palette, results are filtered as you type with the matched letters marked, a lime highlight glides between rows and filter chips slide between Pages, Create and Actions. Running a command spins in a tick, folds the palette back into the pill and sends a glowing comet to the part of the app it changed: a new invoice row, a new customer card, the expenses total, the page itself or the light and dark theme.
how: Press Ctrl K, Cmd K or the slash key, or click the search pill.
Type a few letters, move with the up and down arrows and press Enter, or click a row.
Press Tab to switch between All, Pages, Create and Actions; Escape closes the menu.
Recent commands appear at the top; the demo plays until you click or press a key.
